description:
Configure Lobby Track to collect vehicle license plate information during visitor check-in. Navigate to the settings or configuration menu to add or enable a custom field labeled 'Vehicle License Plate' (or similar). Then, register a new visitor with the following details:
- First Name: Carlos
- Last Name: Mendez
- Company: Pacific Fleet Services
- Vehicle License Plate: 7XKP392
- Host: Sarah Chen

Take a screenshot of the completed registration screen showing the license plate field populated, and save it to '~/Desktop/vehicle_field_verification.png'.
